activity.notes: After the Maastricht Treaty entered into force on 1 November 1993, Delors continued as President of the European Commission within the newly established European Union framework. The Delors Commission remained in office through 23 January 1995.

sources.title: European Commission — Delors III Commission
sources.citation_text: The Commission archive records the Delors Commission as holding office until 23 January 1995.

sources.title: European Commission — Jacques Delors
sources.citation_text: The Commission describes Delors' 1985–1995 presidency and his role in shaping the European Union.
